title: Cozy and Convenient Downtown Condo
description:
Funky, artsy condo in the heart of downtown. Perfect for a weekend away! A 10 minute walk to Broadway.

The space
This cozy condo is in the heart of downtown. You'll love the original art and the quick walk to Broadway or Printer's Alley.

Guest access
Full access to the 1 bedroom condo.

Other things to note
There is a small elevator on premises. It's great for getting your luggage to the 6th floor, but is not ADA compliant due to the age of the building.
